content.text:
I'd come out with about 69 thousand after 8 years and no real answer for 4. I'm fairly sure on the 8 years and not at all on the 4.

- **8 years:** at 500 ₪ a month the calculator says **68,853 "נשאר בידיים"**. I put in 48,000, and it adds "+9,581" under "החזר המס" (tax refund, I think) and "+11,272" under "התשואה הנוספת אחרי דמי ניהול". The bar marked "המס לקח" was 0. That bar chart is what decided it, because it shows the answer clearly once you're past 6 years.
- **4 years:** the fund doesn't give me a number. Years 1–5 are just empty dotted boxes. The orange text says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים", and if you take it out early you pay tax on it like business income. The only number shown at 4 was 25,725. But it sits over an empty dashed box labelled "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך", so I think it's the same money in a regular investment account, not the fund. At first I almost took it as my answer.

How it went:
- The top screen had the heading קרן השתלמות and "אחרי 6 שנים… למשוך… בלי מס".
- I tapped the "מה קורה לכסף בקרן" tab and it jumped straight to the calculator.
- I switched it to "עצמאים". I didn't touch the inputs (12,000 under "הכנסה חייבת בחודש", 500 a month, 7%, 0.54% fees) because the task didn't give me amounts.
- I moved the year slider to 4, then to 8.
- I skipped the rest of the page: "שווה לדעת", "מי מציע ומי מצטרף", and the line about depositing another 13,205 ₪ a year.

Words I didn't get: "הכנסה חייבת" (I left it at 12,000), "מסלול מדד", "החזר המס הוסיף" (where's that refund from?), and "חשבון ניירות ערך".

What bothered me:
- 4 years is the case I really care about, in case I need the money, and it's a blank.
- The round up-arrow button covered the label under the 25,725 bar.
- I didn't know what the teal and yellow chunks in the bars meant until I got to the 8-year breakdown.
